caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a light brown color. The chair features four turned legs with additional horizontal and diagonal supports between them near the bottom. The seat appears flat and wooden, with visible wood grain texture. The back of the chair has two vertical posts capped with finials, a horizontal bar near the top, and a lower horizontal bar with three spindle-shaped, decorative vertical supports. The arms of the chair are simple, cylindrical bars extending from the back posts to vertical posts at the front. The background is a plain beige or light tan color with minimal shading, and there are faint linear indications of a surface or floor beneath the chair. The artist's signature, "Annie Gjer," is present in the bottom right corner.
title: Carver Armchair
